_aide: Example rules for the sample catalogue. To use your own, create regles_catalogue.json next to your catalogue (it is git-ignored). Keys: textes_retires (text removed from category titles), categories_renommees (rename a category when its title equals / contains a text), mots_en_majuscules (words kept in capitals), sections_exclues (a bold title containing one of these words skips its whole section), masques_par_defaut (items containing one of these words are hidden on first launch).
